about_the_game:
Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point – Strategy Meets Engineering

The digital adaptation of the board game Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point challenges players to design bridges with precision—only to watch them collapse spectacularly when necessary. Balancing stability and destruction is key, making every level a clever test of problem-solving and strategy.

A true boardgame experience
As a faithful adaption of the board game, Breaking Point captures the essence of the original physics game while adding a fresh digital twist, allowing players to compete online with their fellow engineering friends all over the world. 

Build with Strategy. Collapse with Style.
Play with your friends in tense, turn-based rounds where you'll draft bridge and vehicle tiles, manage your bridge budget, and push your luck as vehicles threaten to bring your careful constructions tumbling down.

Features

  • Play the official digital adaptation of the hit board game with full rule support and optional tutorials.

  • Strategically draft bridge parts and vehicles each round. Build and reinforce your bridge to survive the oncoming weight and speed of absurd transports like food trucks, giant chickens, and UFOs.

  • Roll the Damage Dice to determine each vehicle’s speed and destructive force—then cross your fingers as the metal meets madness.

  • Use earned money to repair and upgrade your structure. Choose wisely: will you patch the cracks or risk everything for a bonus score?

  • Experience Bridge Constructor in a whole new way and play online with 2–4 players.

  • Earn extra points with Crossing Bonus Cards.
